cadence_definition.primary_gap_metric: actual interval-to-interval gap between an endpoint positive exposure and the independent comparison exposure from the same archive; midpoint differences are prohibited

geometry.exposure_to_solution_association: within the same physical plate, choose the astrometric solution whose solution center is nearest to the exposure pointing; ties prefer larger num_xmatch. Preserve association separation.
geometry.intersection_method: project polygon corners to a shared local tangent plane and compute convex polygon clipping. This is catalogue-footprint opportunity geometry, not final pixel-level WCS validation.

independence.same_archive_comparison_role: allowed because it is a temporal negative/control, not an independent positive observatory

primary_scientific_order: download/freeze APPLAUSE DR4 archive, exposure, scan, and astrometric-solution metadata
construct digitally usable exposure registry (scan + timing + sky footprint)
find within-archive same-field short-cadence comparison opportunities
filter those overlaps by sky-footprint intersection
for each cross-observatory space-time opportunity, identify independent same-archive comparison plates
rank opportunities by prospectively frozen cadence tiers
do not inspect source detections, pixels, Gaia matches, candidate outcomes, or prior transient rankings
scope: Stage 1 of the redesigned global experiment: exhaustively census all 27 APPLAUSE DR4 instrument archives using metadata only. Apply Busko-style short-cadence same-field opportunity selection before any transient/source inspection; then identify physically overlapping exposures at distinct observatory sites; then require catalogue STC footprint intersection; then identify short-lag independent same-archive comparison exposures.
site_map_note: Conservative operational grouping from APPLAUSE archive documentation. Archive 006 is left UNKNOWN and is not permitted to contribute to an observatory-independence claim in v093.
